description.description: A head-and-shoulders medium shot of actor Daniel Radcliffe seated in a grey armchair, holding a microphone in his right hand and gesturing with his left. He is wearing a dark jacket over a dark t-shirt. The background is a dark wall featuring repeating light-colored logos for '92NY'.

A head-and-shoulders portrait of J.K. Rowling. She has medium-length red hair, blue eyes, and is wearing a dark teal or green v-neck dress. She is also wearing green cluster earrings and a red remembrance poppy pin on her left lapel. The background is dark and out of focus with golden bokeh lights.
